# Tokens

Design tokens are named entities that store the visual design attributes of a design system, such as colors, spacings, sizings, font aspects, etc.

They are published as `@airbus/design-tokens` npm package and consumed by our css, react and angular components.

For more details, see https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system/blob/master/packages/design-tokens/README.md

## Using tokens in react

Tokens can be accessed through the `useTheme` hook.

You can find the full list of available tokens by browsing the json properties files here : https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system/tree/master/packages/design-tokens/properties

```js
import { useTheme } from "@airbus/components-react";

export const MyComponent = ({ children }) => {
  const { color } = useTheme();
  return (
    <div style={{ backgroundColor: color.palette.primaryblue[70] }}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
};
```
